dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you can tell me about the war?

dialogues.speaker: Ono
dialogues.text: Before this, I'd thought of many ways in which this conflict could go. Maybe the Shogunate might destroy the resistance by sheer dint of force, or perhaps the resistance might eventually buckle under the pressure and surrender...

dialogues.speaker: Ono
dialogues.text: I never expected the Shogunate to not only gain some advantage, but instead start peace talks with them...

dialogues.speaker: Ono
dialogues.text: To tell the truth, I'm a bit disappointed in the Shogunate leadership's strategy. But at the same time, this ceasefire gladdens me far more.

dialogues.speaker: Ono
dialogues.text: I mean, who among the ordinary citizens of Inazuma really wished to go out there and kill people, am I right?
